svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Millrace Station: map
svg.desc: Plan of Millrace Station: 7 decks stacked on one sheet, from Crown at the top to Keel at the bottom. Each deck has a header with its department, every room carries its name, doors wear their department's colour, and stairs, ladders, a lift and cable risers are marked. The same rooms are listed below the picture.
svg.text: 7 decks stacked, the top deck first. 59 rooms. Floors and doors are coloured by the department that holds the key.

g.text: The hub: quarters, library and chapel
Botany, kitchen, bar and the science labs
Cargo, the moon pool and the Mining Sub
Engineering: the power chain, the workshops, atmospherics and the dive airlock

svg.text: Lift (a cart lift to every deck)
